So this is the 'Gate of Atonement'... // [1]We can get through here without doing anything in particular, can't we? Then let's press on quickly.

strings.tl: So this is the 'Gate of Atonement'...
Say, somebody's dead over there, you know.
Oh my...? Someone appears to have died over there.

strings.read:
{0b:08}【 戦士フォルクマイヤー 】{0b:09}
う・・・{0c:fe}

strings.tl: He's alive. [HERO], let's go back to town!
He's alive! [HERO], we're goin' back to town!
He's alive! [HERO], let's hurry back to town!
He's alive, huh. [HERO], hurry, back to town!
He's alive! [HERO], we have to hurry back to town!
He's alive. [HERO], let's go back to town!
He is still breathing. [HERO], let us return to town!
He is a-alive. // [1][HERO]-san, let us return to town! My magic can do no more than dull the pain!
Oh, I'm so glad, he's alive. // [1][HERO]-san, let's go back to town, okay? My magic can only make the pain a little better!
Oh, so he is alive. I suppose there is nothing for it. Shall we return to town?
If we are going back, do let us be quick about it.

strings.en:
{0c:51082b501000}{1c:23}{0b:08}【 Eve 】{0b:09}
What is it? Aren't we going back, dear?{0c:fe}
strings.tl: What is it? Aren't we going back, dear?
No... I'm... I'm done for... // [1]Never mind that... // My comrade... save my comrade... Omberto's... still inside...

strings.en:
{1c:21}{0b:08}【 Orpheus 】{0b:09}
There is someone in there?{0c:020301}

{1c:23}{0b:08}【 Eve 】{0b:09}
There's still someone in there?{0c:fe}

strings.tl: All that... big talk... and still... // can't save... one lousy comrade... Pathetic... makes me wanna weep...
Don't talk anymore! The blood in your lungs...
Please do not speak any more. We will save you, I promise!

strings.en:
{0c:521820}{0c:0c14}{1c:11}{0b:08}【 Ash 】{0b:09}
You'd better not talk anymore!{0c:020501}

strings.tl: You'd better not talk. You'll choke on your blood, you know.
You had best not talk. You would choke on your blood, I daresay.
Guess I just... can't ever be... like Mister Valdes... after all... // [HERO]... please... // In my... place... Omberto...
Well, it can't be helped, I suppose... So, shall we go?

strings.en:
{1c:21}{0b:08}【 Orpheus 】{0b:09}
{10}-san...{07:14} Shall we be off, then?{07:05}{0c:fe}
